worldcombat.skill.acidspray.summary: Spray a short, wide acid mist: every enemy in the wedge takes special damage and immediately loses 2 stages of Sp. Def; the mist lingers and drenches anyone who steps in; the focused nozzle is narrower, longer and harder per hit, the wide spray covers a whole group.
worldcombat.skill.acidspray.use.0: Strip two stages of Sp. Def off a group in front at close range
worldcombat.skill.acidspray.use.1: Grind Sp. Def with the cheapest possible cast
worldcombat.skill.acidspray.use.2: Spray the chokepoint as foes try to push through
The spray deals %1$s special damage to each enemy it drenches and lowers its Sp. Def by %2$s stage(s).
The mist covers a %1$s-block, %2$s-degree wedge in front and spits about %3$s droplets.
The mist lingers %1$s; anyone entering the wedge takes %2$s more damage and also loses %3$s stage(s) of Sp. Def (once per target).
worldcombat.skill.acidspray.focus.on: Focused nozzle: damage %1$s, range %2$s blocks, but only a %3$s-degree opening, shorter mist and +5 ticks cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.acidspray.focus.off: Wide spray: a %1$s-block, %2$s-degree wedge drenches several foes at once.
worldcombat.skill.acidspray.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.acidspray.growth.0: From level %1$s the spray rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks of range.
worldcombat.skill.acidspray.preference.f: On: opening cut to 55%, range ×1.3 and damage ×1.15, but a shorter mist and +5 ticks cooldown — for grinding one target up close. Off (wide): the widest opening, drenching several foes in front at once.
worldcombat.skill.acidspray.preference.a: Beyond this distance the companion closes in first. Larger values let it approach from further away before spraying.
On: when other enemies stand around it, it prioritizes the spray, drenching several at once. Off: it sorts like an ordinary attack.
